summary.text: Greg Smith is a Republican state representative from Oregon House District 57 in eastern Oregon who has served since 2001 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business development professional and small business owner, he lives in Heppner.

paragraphs.text: Greg Smith earned a B.S. in liberal studies from Eastern Oregon University in 1992 and an M.S. in business administration from the same school.

Ballotpedia says he was previously a legislative aide to Oregon Representative Greg Walden, a community advisory member for U.S. Senator Gordon Smith, and an alternate delegate to the 1996 Republican National Convention.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Smith said he lives in Heppner with his wife and family, represents nine counties in eastern Oregon, and is the longest-serving member of the Oregon House.
He also said he stands for life, defends the Second Amendment, backs law enforcement, and fights for farmers and ranchers.
